headline: Team competitor sheet merged
detail: Programmes we did not hold were added from the Power BI competitor sheet; only blank fields were filled on programmes we already had. 60 duplicate cohort rows and 9 Coursera/edX rows dropped.

headline: 5 ISB programmes confirmed live and added
detail: Chief Strategy Officer Programme, General Management Programme, ISB-NUS Global Advanced Management Programme, Business Strategy (ISB Online), EY-ISB Board Effectiveness for Women.

headline: Peer set widened to 19
detail: Added IIM Indore, SP Jain, HEC Paris, Kellogg, Stanford and four platforms (Emeritus, Imarticus, Jaro, TimesPro). Platform listings carrying a school's brand now count under that school.

headline: ISB product workbook checked against the catalogue
detail: Four ISB Online programmes were missing and are now added (fees still to be captured). Leadership Essentials (ISB Online) and Essentials of Leadership (campus) are now kept as separate products. Fees on the live site were kept where the workbook's Open Portfolio tab shows older, lower figures.

headline: Peer new-launch register added: 68 launches in the last 12 months
detail: Hand-verified register from the Product Team (26 Oct 2025 to 26 Oct 2026): Wharton 6, INSEAD 6, LBS 4, IMD 7, IIM-A 3, IIM-B 14, IIM-C 8, IIM-K 17, IIM-L 3, HBS 0. 31 are probable (school marks them new, no announcement date). 21 more checked and not counted.

headline: The dashboard is now a monthly brief
detail: Opens on what changed and what it means for ISB, with a page per topic, a programme-idea test, ISB's price position against its closest peers, and a timeline of peer launches.

headline: Search is now the home page
detail: Search any programme by topic, role, school or keyword; programmes other schools launched in the last year carry a New launch tag. Demand is described in words, and each call has its own colour.

headline: Programme names now open the programme's own page
detail: Each name links to its landing page where one exists, else its page in the school's catalogue, else its brochure; the programme page lists all three. 1,287 of 1,408 programmes now link to a page of their own, up from 1,062: links came from the Product Team's own files and the schools' catalogues and calendars, and each was opened on 29 Oct. Home pages, shared calendars and page titles held as links were replaced.

headline: 190 missing fees filled
detail: Programmes without a fee fell from 283 to 93. Fees were read off the schools' live pages on 29 Oct (IIM-B 66, Wharton 55, INSEAD 22, LBS 16, IIM-C 13, IMD 6, HBS 5 and others), plus 6 from the team's benchmarking files that are marked as not yet re-checked. Five programmes whose pages are gone are noted, not priced.

headline: ISB fees checked against ISB's live pages
detail: All direct ISB fees matched. Cybersecurity for Leaders was held as ₹14,900 and is ₹1,49,900. Management Essentials, Business Technology & Innovation with AI and Fintech Innovations now forward to other ISB pages, and General Management Programme forwards to AGMP: check whether they are still sold.

headline: Second pass on links and fees
detail: 1,324 of 1,408 programme names now open a page of their own (from 1,287) and 71 programmes lack a fee (from 93). New: IIM Indore's own programme pages, IIM-L and IIM-K brochures, partner pages for IIM-L long programmes, IIM-A online course fees, Wharton Online fees and IIM-K brochure fees. Course-aggregator listings are no longer used as programme links. Most programmes still unlinked are short IIM-L and IIM-K courses that no longer appear on the schools' calendars.

headline: 55 programmes marked as likely discontinued
detail: Kept, but marked on every list and programme page with the reason: the page is gone or now sends visitors to another programme (14: IIM-L partner programmes 5, ISB 4, Wharton 2, IIM-B, IIM-A and INSEAD 1 each), not found on the school's current pages (10), or a short course missing from the IIM-L or IIM-K calendar whose last run has passed (31). Search has a Hide likely discontinued filter and the spreadsheet download has a status column. They still count in topic and fee comparisons until a refresh confirms them.

headline: School pages, weekly refresh, ISB brand; calls removed
detail: Indian schools and Global schools tabs open a tile per school and its full portfolio (CXO programmes, blended, live online, campus, self-paced) under the search filters. New launches now leads with the themes and levels other schools are launching in. Where ISB stands and the Lead/Follow/Defend calls are gone. The refresh runs every Monday and has a second pass for links: a programme name no longer opens a news article, listing site, calendar or short link.

headline: HEC fees with a space before the thousands now read correctly
detail: HEC writes fees as "55 300 €" and the team-sheet import stopped at the space, so 8 HEC programmes were held at €22 to €55 instead of €22,500 to €55,900. Three are on the dashboard (Executive MSc in Finance, Executive MSc in Change Leadership, Executive MSc in Geopolitics and Geo-economics of Emerging Africa) and show under Repriced this week; HEC did not change its prices. No other school's fees moved.

headline: What changed: before vs after, school by school
detail: A new tab compares the programme data as first fed in on 30 Sep (before) with the database today (after), with an Indian and a Global button and one tile per school. 1,138 programmes before and 1,408 after: 423 added (90 of them IMD, which was not in before), 70 no longer shown, 75 platform listings moved under their own school, and 185 fees, 126 formats and 321 links that differ. Each school's page lists every change and downloads as CSV. The week-on-week lists and this log moved here from the Updates page.

headline: 50 programmes that had no topic are now tagged and shown
detail: The keyword tagger could not place 50 programmes, so the dashboard left them out: 15 French-language HEC programmes, 8 at Stanford, 7 at IIM Indore, 6 at Kellogg and 14 across IIM-A, IIM-C, IIM-K, IIM-L, INSEAD and Emeritus. Each now has a topic chosen from its name (data/overrides.csv), and no programme already tagged changed topic. 1,458 programmes are on the dashboard (from 1,408). In What changed, removed falls from 70 to 22, all out of scope: 11 degree programmes, 10 Coursera or edX courses and 1 faculty programme.

headline: What changed now works over a period you pick
detail: The What changed tab compares each school's catalogue now with the start of a period you choose, from last week to last year, instead of with the competitor sheet. Tiles say what each school did and count new programmes, programmes gone, fees raised or cut, and changes to length, modules, format and topics; a school's page shows every change, the old value next to the new one in red. Every refresh now logs what moved, with its date (history from 30 Sep). From 23 Nov the Monday refresh re-reads half of all programme pages each week, IIMs first, so a school's own changes can be told apart from corrections to our records, which are hidden unless you include them.

headline: Two ISB programmes shown under their new names
detail: Business Technology & Innovation with AI is now Digital Business Transformation with AI, and General Management Programme is now Senior Management Programme. Both new names were already listed, so the old rows, marked likely discontinued, are removed rather than counted twice. Renames are now caught for every school: programmes that look gone are scored against live programmes at the same school (page forwarding, shared name words, matching fee, length, modules and format), and the Monday refresh confirms each on the school's own pages before it is applied. What changed shows a rename as one change.

headline: Four ISB programmes removed as discontinued
detail: ISB confirms Management Essentials, Fintech Innovations: From Blockchain to AI, Certificate Programme in Healthcare Leadership and Certificate Programme in Digital Transformation are no longer sold. They were marked likely discontinued and are now removed, so ISB shows 44 programmes. Management Essentials' old page forwarded to Executive Programme in Business Management, but it was not a rename.

headline: What changed now shows launches and fee changes read from schools' pages
detail: New launches from the Product Team's register now appear on What changed on their launch dates (6 in the last quarter, 31 in the last year), with the themes they fall in. A fee, length or module count read from a school's own page on two dates now counts as the school's change when it moved by less than half: 7 ISB fees rose between our checks on 26 Sep and 29 Oct (median +4.1%). Bigger jumps stay corrections to our records. A programme marked likely discontinued and then removed counts once.

headline: What changed is dated by when schools act, not when we record
detail: Each change now carries the days in which the school made it: between the last check that saw the old state on the school's page and the first that saw the new one, or the school's own date for a launch. ISB's fee rises are dated 26 Sep to 29 Oct; the two renames happened before our first check on 26 Sep and are listed as found, not as recent changes. A change counts in a period when its window, at most 35 days, overlaps it.
